entries.name: Brandon Aiyuk
entries.summary: Aiyuk's agent, Drew Rosenhaus, said Tuesday that the receiver is "100 percent healthy" and fully recovered from his November 2024 right knee surgery and plans to work out for interested teams once he's released by the 49ers, Dianna Russini of BetUS TV reports.

entries.name: Jake Ferguson
entries.summary: out

entries.name: Jared Wiley
entries.summary: Wiley suffered a fractured ankle in the Chiefs' 35-13 victory over the Falcons on Sunday, Matt Derrick of ChiefsDigest.com reports.

entries.name: Jordan Addison
entries.summary: Head coach Kevin O'Connell said Wednesday that Addison underwent thumb surgery earlier this week and won't be placed on injured reserve, Alec Lewis of The Athletic reports.

entries.name: Josh Jacobs
entries.summary: Jacobs (finger) has a "realistic chance" of returning to action Nov. 25 against the Rams following the Packers' Week 11 bye, Ian Rapoport of NFL Network reports.

entries.name: Kyler Murray
entries.summary: Murray (hamstring) will miss Wednesday's practice, Kevin Seifert of ESPN reports.

entries.name: Sam Darnold
entries.summary: Head coach Mike Macdonald said Monday that he's "really optimistic" Darnold (quadriceps/ribs) will be able to get a full week's worth of practice coming out of the Seahawks' Week 11 bye and start their next game Sunday, Nov. 29, against the 49ers, John Boyle of the team's official site reports.

entries.name: Will Mallory
entries.summary: Mallory (hamstring) was estimated as a non-participant for Tuesday's practice walkthrough.

entries.name: Zachariah Branch
entries.summary: out

entries.name: Drake Maye
entries.summary: Patriots head coach Mike Vrabel said Monday that he didn't have a definitive diagnosis for the injury Maye (ankle) sustained in Sunday's 35-10 loss to the Lions in Munich, but indicated that the quarterback will miss time," Phil Perry of NBC Sports Boston reports.  "I wouldn't imagine him being available coming out of the [Week 11] bye," Vrabel said.

entries.name: Woody Marks
entries.summary: Marks (concussion) didn't practice Tuesday.

entries.name: A.J. Brown
entries.summary: Brown (hamstring) was spotted walking around with a limp in the locker room following Sunday's 35-10 loss to the Lions in Munich, Andrew Callahan of the Boston Herald reports.

entries.name: Anthony Gould
entries.summary: Gould (toe) is listed as questionable for Thursday night's game against the Texans, Abby Halpin of the Colts' official site reports.

entries.name: Baker Mayfield
entries.summary: Coach Todd Bowles said Wednesday that Mayfield (foot), who didn't practice Wednesday, is "a lot better" than he was a week ago, Scott Smith of the Buccaneers' official site reports.

entries.name: Bo Melton
entries.summary: Melton (thigh) has been ruled out for the rest of Sunday's game against the Vikings, Rob Demovsky of ESPN.com reports.

entries.name: Brenen Thompson
entries.summary: Thompson (hamstring) is inactive for Monday night's game against the Ravens.

entries.name: Brevin Jordan
entries.summary: Jordan (foot/illness) did not participate at practice Tuesday.

entries.name: Brock Bowers
entries.summary: Bowers (ankle) wasn't spotted on the field for Wednesday's practice, Ryan McFadden of ESPN.com reports.

entries.name: Carnell Tate
entries.summary: Titans head coach Robert Saleh said that Tate (shoulder) will practice Wednesday, Turron Davenport of ESPN.com reports.

entries.name: Chris Bell
entries.summary: Bell (knee) is viewed as day-to-day ahead of Sunday's game against the Bills, Marcel Louis-Jacques of ESPN.com reports.

entries.name: CJ Donaldson
entries.summary: questionable

entries.name: DeVonta Smith
entries.summary: Coach Nick Sirianni indicated Wednesday that he feels good about Smith (hamstring) returning to action Sunday against the Steelers, Jeff McLane of The Philadelphia Inquirer reports.

entries.name: Dont'e Thornton Jr.
entries.summary: questionable

entries.name: Dontayvion Wicks
entries.summary: Coach Nick Sirianni relayed Wednesday that he feels good about the chances of Wicks (ankle) returning to action Sunday against the Steelers, Jeff McLane of The Philadelphia Inquirer reports.

entries.name: Geno Smith
entries.summary: Jets head coach Aaron Glenn said that Smith (ankle) will be a limited participant in Wednesday's practice, Brian Costello of the New York Post reports.

entries.name: George Holani
entries.summary: Holani is week-to-week after suffering an MCL sprain in Sunday's win over Las Vegas, Ian Rapoport of NFL Network reported Monday.

entries.name: Isaiah Williams
entries.summary: Jets head coach Aaron Glenn said that Williams won't practice Wednesday due to a rib injury, Eric Allen of the Jets' official site reports.

entries.name: Jared Wayne
entries.summary: questionable

entries.name: Jauan Jennings
entries.summary: questionable

entries.name: Jaydn Ott
entries.summary: questionable

entries.name: Jaylen Waddle
entries.summary: Waddle (concussion) has been ruled out for the remainder of Sunday's game against the Panthers, Parker Gabriel of The Denver Post reports.

entries.name: Jonathan Mingo
entries.summary: questionable

entries.name: Kenneth Walker III
entries.summary: Walker (groin) won't practice Wednesday, Sam McDowell of The Kansas City Star reports.

entries.name: Kyle Monangai
entries.summary: Monangai (toe/thumb) was seen wearing full pads for the Bears' unofficial practice Tuesday, Adam Jahns of AllCHGO.com reports.

entries.name: Ladd McConkey
entries.summary: questionable

entries.name: Marvin Harrison Jr.
entries.summary: Harrison (hamstring) was a non-participant in Tuesday's practice.

entries.name: Mike Evans
entries.summary: Head coach Kyle Shanahan said Evans (Achilles) won't practice Wednesday but hopes the wide receiver will return to drills Thursday, Nick Wagoner of ESPN.com reports.

entries.name: Omar Cooper Jr.
entries.summary: Cooper (ankle) isn't practicing Wednesday, Brian Costello of the New York Post reports.

entries.name: Skyy Moore
entries.summary: Moore's ankle injury is not considered serious, Jeremy Fowler of ESPN.com reports.

entries.name: T.J. Hockenson
entries.summary: Head coach Kevin O'Connell said Wednesday that the Vikings hope Hockenson (wrist/chest) returns to action Sunday against the 49ers in Mexico City, Kevin Seifert of ESPN.com reports.

entries.name: Andrei Iosivas
entries.summary: Iosivas (thumb) has been downgraded from doubtful to out for Sunday's game against the Steelers.

entries.name: Gardner Minshew II
entries.summary: Minshew (elbow) underwent UCL reconstructive surgery Monday, Jeremy Fowler of ESPN.com reports.

entries.name: Jacory Croskey-Merritt
entries.summary: The Commanders designated Croskey-Merritt (groin) for return from injured reserve Tuesday.

entries.name: Jalen McMillan
entries.summary: Head coach Todd Bowles suggested Monday that McMillan (knee) isn't likely to immediately return to action following the Buccaneers' Week 10 bye, Rick Stroud of the Tampa Bay Times reports.

entries.name: James Conner
entries.summary: Updating a previous report, Conner (foot) no longer appears to be a candidate to return from injured reserve to play Week 11 versus the Chiefs, according to Tyler Drake of ArizonaSports.com.

entries.name: Jonathon Brooks
entries.summary: Brooks (groin) was a full participant at Wednesday's walkthrough.

entries.name: Lamar Jackson
entries.summary: The Ravens believe "there's a chance" that Jackson (thumb) could return for their Week 16 matchup with the Browns, assuming all goes well in his recovery from right thumb surgery, Dan Graziano of ESPN.com reports.

entries.name: Malik Willis
entries.summary: Head coach Jeff Hafley said Monday that Willis (groin/core) has not undergone surgery and that the Dolphins are still determining if a procedure is needed, David Furones of the South Florida Sun Sentinel reports.

entries.name: Michael Pittman Jr.
entries.summary: Steelers head coach Mike McCarthy said Wednesday that Pittman (foot) has been designated for return from injured reserve, Nick Farabaugh of PennLive.com reports.

entries.name: Mo Alie-Cox
entries.summary: The Colts placed Alie-Cox (groin) on injured reserve Saturday.

entries.name: Roman Wilson
entries.summary: Steelers head coach Mike McCarthy said Wednesday that Wilson (finger) has been designated for return from injured reserve, Nick Farabaugh of PennLive.com reports.

entries.name: Tyler Goodson
entries.summary: The Cowboys placed Goodson (knee) on injured reserve Saturday, Tommy Yarrish of the team's official site reports.

entries.name: Wan'Dale Robinson
entries.summary: Coach Robert Saleh said Wednesday that Robinson (ankle) -- who was placed on IR on Tuesady -- is out for the rest of the season, Terry McCormick of TitanInsider.com reports.

entries.name: Will Shipley
entries.summary: The Eagles opened Shipley's (foot) 21-day practice window Monday.

entries.name: Zavier Scott
entries.summary: The Bears placed Scott (wrist) on injured reserve Thursday.
